cues: Her mind barely follows his words; she is drinking in his voice.
She wants to touch his face in the dark, to whisper against his cheek, as she might have done, Chopin writes, if she had not been a respectable woman.
Then the sentence on which the story turns: the stronger the impulse grew to bring herself near him, the further did she draw away.
